bio: I'm a Full-Stack Developer with hands-on experience building and deploying production web applications using the MERN stack, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Redis, and AWS.
Skilled in real-time features, secure authentication, and payment integrations, with a strong focus on writing clean, scalable code and delivering products from design to deployment.
Currently working at Abhyaas Edu Technologies, where I build and maintain production-grade web applications that serve thousands of users.
